description.value: Choices Market on Commercial Drive is part of Western Canada's largest natural and organic food grocery chain, emphasizing locally sourced and Canadian-produced products. The Commercial Drive location sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors, making it a convenient provisioning stop for touring cyclists passing through the city. The store carries an extensive selection of organic, natural, and local food items.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 28m; rack at 65m; rack at 70m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Commercial Drive store location with matching address (1045 Commercial Drive, V5L 3X1) and phone ((604) 678 9665), corroborating all OSM contact fields. The site identifies Choices Markets as 'Western Canada's largest grocer of natural and organic foods,' confirming basic groceries. No website or OSM content addresses bike parking, water refill, or most other cycling amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to an online shopping portal rather than a general store information page, which limits the depth of amenity detail available from the website fetch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established natural and organic grocery store on Vancouver's Commercial Drive cycling corridor — a clear and useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists.
